property.description: A section of code flash exists between the end of the vector table (near the start of flash) and the ROM registers (at address 0x400). Selecting 'Fill gap' will assume a compiler optimization for size and fill this area with a preselected set functions in order to reduce the amount of code flash used by FSP. If you would like to fill this area with your own code or data, select 'Do not fill gap' and manually place items in the section '.flash_gap'.

node.tooltip: Click to edit the XTAL frequency.
The system clock (ICLK) is used as the operating clock of the CPU, DTC, ROM and RAM. \nIt should not exceed 48 MHz.
The Peripheral clock B (PCLKB) is used as the operating clock for all other modules not supported by PCLKD. \nIt should not exceed 32 MHz.

The Peripheral clock D (PCLKD) is used as the operating clock for the GPT (count clock) module and ADC12.\nWhen ADC12 is not used PCLKD cannot exceed 64MHz. When ADC12 is used PCLKD must be at least 1MHz and cannot exceed 64MHz.
